Container.Name: sluice
Container.Overview:
Sluice mines Twitch drops without a browser. It finds active drop campaigns, watches eligible channels and claims rewards on its own.
First run: open the container's log (or the WebUI) and enter the code it shows at twitch.tv/activate. Everything else is created in the appdata folder on launch.
The dashboard has no password. To open it by hostname from another machine, add that hostname to "allowedHosts" in config.json. Don't run it on the same Twitch account as another copy of Sluice.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Settings, Twitch login and history. Created on first launch.

Config.Name: TZ
Config.Description: Time zone for logs and the run schedule.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User that owns the data folder.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group that owns the data folder.

Config.Name: SLUICE_CLIENT_TOKEN
Config.Description: Optional. Only needed to link a Steam library from a non-release build.
